doc.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: New York clubs and the Embers trio
title: Tommy Dorsey at the Statler and Charlie Shavers put out of the car
summary: While living in Long Beach they heard Tommy Dorsey's band with Buddy Rich and Charlie Shavers, and she repeats the story of Dorsey leaving Shavers on the road.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Oh, yeah. Back to while we were working in Long Beach. We would come in, and Tommy Dorsey was holding forth at the Statler Hotel. I heard a lot of people with his band. I don’t think Frank Sinatra was there anymore, but Jimmy knew Tommy very well. So he would like to go there several nights and hang out. I remember Buddy Rich was in that band and Charlie Shavers was in the band. We used to hear all these stories about how terrible Tommy was. He had a quarrel with Charlie Shavers on the . . . driving to another gig, and he put Charlie Shavers out of the car and left him on the road and drove away. Isn’t that awful?
It is. Especially in those times, to say the least, or any times, for that matter.
Anyway, that has nothing to do with anything.
